findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the same key material is used indefinitely. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and violates common cryptographic key-management requirements.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root full control of the key, meaning any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms permissions may decrypt the log data. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict encrypt/decrypt to the specific log delivery and reader principals.
